verdict.rationale: Riveter provides run-level monitoring via webhooks (run.completed, run.stopped, run.finished) and a Runs.List/status endpoint for tracking job outcomes, plus dry_run and max_credits guardrails that validate requests before execution. However there is no evidence of data-quality validation (schema checks, anomaly detection, row-level QA) or performance metrics/dashboards, only credit estimation and completion/failure events. missing for 10: dedicated data-quality validation tooling, job performance metrics/dashboards, independent corroboration of alerting reliability.
